v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Dómine, * probásti me et cognovísti me. ‡
text.en: Lord, * thou hast proved me, and known me. ‡

text.la: Mirabília ópera tua, * Dómine, et ánima mea cognóscit nimis.
text.en: Wonderful are thy works * and my soul knoweth right well.

text.la: Ne derelínquas me, * Dómine, virtus salútis meæ.
text.en: Do not thou forsake me, * O Lord, the strength of my salvation.

text.la: Dómine, * clamávi ad te, exáudi me. ‡
text.en: I have cried to thee, * O Lord, hear me. ‡

text.la: Educ de custódia * ánimam meam, Dómine, ad confiténdum nómini tuo.
text.en: Bring my soul * out of prison, O Lord, that I may praise thy name.

text.la: Ecce sacérdos magnus, qui in diébus suis plácuit Deo, et invéntus est iustus: et in témpore iracúndiæ factus est reconciliátio.
text.en: Behold an high priest, who in his days pleased God, and was found righteous, and in the time of wrath he was made a propitiation.

v.la: Iustum dedúxit Dóminus per vias rectas.
v.en: The Lord guided the just in right paths.

r.en: And showed him the kingdom of God.

text.la: O Doctor óptime, * Ecclésiæ sanctæ lumen, beáte Augustíne, divínæ legis amátor, deprecáre pro nobis Fílium Dei.
text.en: O right excellent Teacher * Light of the Holy Church, Augustine, blessed lover of the Divine Law, pray for us to the Son of God.

text.la: Adésto supplicatiónibus nostris, omnípotens Deus: et, quibus fidúciam sperándæ pietátis indúlges, intercedénte beáto Augustíno Confessóre tuo atque Pontífice, consuétæ misericórdiæ tríbue benígnus efféctum.
text.en: Graciously hear our supplications, O Almighty God, and as Thou hast given unto us the hope that we are of the number of them upon whom Thou wilt show mercy, grant unto us in thy goodness, that, helped by the prayers of thy blessed Confessor and Bishop Augustine, we may experience the fulfillment of thine accustomed loving-kindness.

office.title: S. Augustini Episcopi et Confessoris et Ecclesiæ Doctoris
